commit.message:
Initial commit: Complete Sunny Payment Gateway platform

- Universal payment gateway with 135+ currencies support
- Multi-platform integration capabilities (Shopify, WooCommerce, APIs, Webhooks)
- Dynamic wallet service supporting MetaMask, Trust Wallet, Coinbase, etc.
- Advanced crypto payment processing (BTC, ETH, USDT, USDC)
- AI-powered payment routing and fraud detection
- Comprehensive security features (PCI DSS, biometric auth, HSM)
- Multi-language support and global coverage (190+ countries)
- Developer-friendly APIs, SDKs, and documentation
- Production-ready infrastructure with monitoring and compliance
